verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay is a media-over-QUIC relay/CDN server that connects publishers to subscribers. It has no agent or LLM component that could act as an MCP client and use tools, so plugging in MCP servers is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP-client capability that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
